top.description: FEDERAL CAPITAL TERRITORY LOTTERY REGULATORY OFFICE (FCT-LRO) O ﬃ ce of the Director-General PUBLIC NOTICE TO GAMING OPERATORS AND THE GENERAL PUBLIC. FCT-LRO COMMENCES FULL BUSINESS OPERATIONS The Federal Capital Territory Lottery Regulatory Oﬃce (FCT-LRO) hereby informs gaming operators, industry stakeholders and the general public that the Oﬃce has commenced operations as the regulatory authority responsible for the oversight, regulation and supervision of gaming activities within the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). 1. REGULATORY JURISDICTION Following the Supreme Court judgment in Attorney-General of Lagos State & 21 Others v. Attorney-General of the Federation & 15 Others, Suit No. SC/1/2008, the constitutional position on the regulation of lotteries and gaming has been clarified. By virtue of Section 299 of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended), the FCT has a distinct constitutional status, with the National Assembly exercising legislative powers ordinarily vested in a State House of Assembly. Accordingly, gaming operators conducting business within the FCT are required to comply with the applicable FCT licensing and regulatory requirements and engage with the FCT- LRO on all regulatory matters. 2. ONLINE GAMING OPERATIONS The Oﬃce clarifies that the Supreme Court judgment did not expressly settle the full regulatory framework applicable to online gaming. In particular, the judgment did not establish that any one State has exclusive regulatory control over the online gaming market. Accordingly, the online gaming market remains open to operators and investors. Operators are free to choose the regulator from whom they wish to obtain their gaming licence or authorisation, based on their business model, operational needs and the regulatory framework they consider most suitable and beneficial to their business. This choice may be exercised without undue interference, intimidation or coercive treatment by any State regulator solely on the basis that an operator has elected to obtain its licence from another regulator, as every state is duly empowered to regulate gaming activities within its relevant jurisdiction. Operators are, however, reminded that the online nature of a gaming platform does not, in itself, exempt an operation from applicable licensing and regulatory obligations where such obligations arise. The FCT-LRO remains committed to providing a transparent, consistent and predictable regulatory environment for digital gaming operations within the Federal Capital Territory. 3. top.title: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers
top.description: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New England Patriots lost to the Green Bay Packers in a brutal Week 9 blowout loss. While the struggles of Christian Gonzalez were alarming, one of the more worrying things from this game was Drake Maye's performance. After seemingly getting back on track following a rough start to the season, Maye has regressed again, throwing three more interceptions against the Packers during Sunday's loss. ESPN's Mike Reiss believes that it's time to be worried about Maye, as his interception problem should have the Patriots and their fans concerned. Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye's INT problem "The Patriots haven't had a positive turnover differential in a game this season and are now minus-11 on the year," Reiss writes. "So there is a high level of concern, especially for a team hoping to make a deep playoff run." Maye threw three interceptions against the Packers in Week 9, and now has 11 total picks on the season. He has already surpassed his eight-interception total from a year ago. He's clearly struggling more than normal, and that's even though his 2,282 passing yards are sixth in the NFL, his 18 passing touchdowns are tied for fourth, and his 73.7 QBR is fifth-best in the league. But his turnover problem is really hurting the Patriots' odds to win these games where his turnover problems really come into play. MORE : Mike Vrabel gives blunt assessment of Christian Gonzalez's struggles The Patriots are 5-4 on the season, and if Maye can't figure things out, they might be in real jeopardy of falling out of a playoff position. While New England might still make the playoffs, the inconsistency of Maye with these interceptions makes it hard to believe in this team come the playoffs. Seeing Maye fix this interception problem might be the difference in this team being able to go on a deep playoff run or not. After another brutal performance, throwing three interceptions in one game, it's hard to believe in Maye right now. Patriots fans and the team should be concerned about Maye, as his turnover struggles are really hurting the team right now and could become a major problem if they don't go away soon. top.title: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ
top.description: Dominic Cotroneo, who's been a fixture on Milwaukee Brewers pregame and postgame coverage since midway through the 2022 season, announced on X that he was leaving WTMJ radio, noting that the maneuver was "100% my decision" and that he doesn't have a fixed plan for what comes next. "I wish them nothing but the best; they gave me an opportunity in the 2022 season to be the new postgame radio host, and that's not an honor I take lightly," Cotroneo said Monday, Nov. 9. "I did the best that I could, and I think WTMJ appreciated my efforts. Sometimes it's OK to say goodbye." Cotroneo, 32, has a number of irons in the fire. He frequently offers Brewers coverage on his YouTube channel and has been working independently on the Service Time podcast, a deep dive into the history of labor in Major League Baseball – a timely topic given the swirling winds around an MLB lockout likely beginning Dec. 1. With so much unknown for next season for myself and the industry, I wanted to build on a YouTube base that grew quickly during the postseason. I can create baseball content on my own volition and prepare for spring training (whenever that is) — Dominic Cotroneo (@Dom_Cotroneo) November 9, 2026 Cotroneo's coverage with WTMJ included "Brewers Extra Innings," the station's postgame call-in show, and later included "Brewers Warmup" before network pregame coverage, the "Brewers Weekly" program on Thursday nights and written coverage on the radio station's website. WTMJ has been the flagship station for Brewers game broadcasts for almost the entirety of the franchise's time in Milwaukee. He has also operated as the "talent stats" guru for Brewers.TV broadcasts and filled a similar role for TBS, often doing in-game research to supplement broadcasts. Cotroneo makes no bones about his desire to move into an MLB play-by-play role. His previous experience as a minor-league announcer included stops in Orem, Utah; Kinston, North Carolina; and Corpus Christi, Texas. His father, Vince, called MLB games for 32 years, with tenures working for the Houston Astros, Texas Rangers and Oakland Athletics. Vince cut his teeth in a similar role to the one Dominic holds now, working alongside legendary broadcaster Milo Hamilton. "I don't know what the future holds for any of this, between the lockout, play-by-play jobs … it gets to a point where you need to take a leap of faith," Dominic said. "It doesn't mean I'm going to leave Milwaukee or leave this market." This article originally appeared on Milwaukee Journal Sentinel: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ

top.title: Which Bengals have won NFL MVP award? Is Joe Burrow next?
top.description: Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is considered by many to be the frontrunner for this season's AP NFL Most Valuable Player award, which would be his first. Burrow is on pace for more than 5,000 passing yards and 55 passing touchdowns. Burrow had a career-best 4,918 passing yards with 43 passing TDs in 2024. Only two Bengals have won the award: QB Boomer Esiason in 1988, and QB Ken Anderson in 1981. During analysis on NFL Network ahead of the Bengals' NFL Week 9 win against Atlanta in Madrid, Pro Football Hall of Famer Kurt Warner said he thinks Burrow, Warner's NFL MVP pick, can lead the team back to the Super Bowl. Joe Burrow would be the third Bengals QB to win AP NFL MVP award. Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen had been considered the frontrunner for the award before Burrow's impressive recent run of 16 passing TDs over the past four games. Burrow was one of five finalists for the 2024 award, which Allen won . Burrow finished the 2024 season as the league leader in passing yards and touchdown passes . Burrow added a rushing TD against Atlanta, and reacted with a unique celebration . Before the game, Burrow greeted Spanish soccer star Ferran Torres. After the game, Burrow said Ja'Marr Chase "was unbelievable" against Atlanta, swapped jerseys with Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, and told reporters he'd love to play in the first NFL game in Tokyo. top.title: Lexi Thompson believes WTGL will help grow the game of golf
top.description: LPGA golfers pose for a photo during WTGL Media Day at SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida on September 20, 2026. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co The future is here. WTGL kicked off on Sunday, Los Angeles Golf Club defeated New York , and it is already back in action. Tuesday will see L.A. take on Motor City Golf Club, Lexi Thompson’s team. Women’s golf has grown so much over the last 20 years and that time span just about directly coincides with Lexi’s professional career. She has been such a trailblazer in the game, and she continues to be with WTGL in general, but that she is taking it on while carrying a child is an entirely different level of impressiveness. This year may mark the first literal season of WTGL, but it has been in the works for a long time if you really think about it. top.title: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report
top.description: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report In a major development, Florian Plettenberg of Sky Germany reports that Barcelona have made an enquiry for Bayern Munich defensive mainstay Jonathan Tah. The Blaugrana are scouring the market for an experienced defender to partner Pau Cubarsi at the heart of the defence and see the German international as an appealing target. Tah back on Barcelona’s radar Tah is a name very familiar to Barcelona, considering that they had shown a strong interest in signing him back in 2025, when his contract at Bayer Leverkusen was expiring. The La Liga champions explored the possibility of a move but decided not to sign him, and he ended up moving to Bayern Munich. Since joining the Bundesliga title holders, the 30-year-old has grown into a mainstay at the back, racking up 67 appearances in which he has three goals and assists each. Back on Barcelona’s radar. (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images) As per the report, Barcelona director Deco and manager Hansi Flick continue to rate Tah highly, and therefore, an enquiry has now been made regarding his availability. January move not an option However, the journalist states that, as things stand, a January move for Tah is not seen as viable for Barcelona. The German international is settled well at Bayern Munich, who themselves have no intentions of letting the centre-back leave the club in January. As such, Barça’s interest is unlikely to proceed beyond the enquiry that has been made for the 30-year-old defender, whose contract at the Allianz Arena runs until the summer of 2029. Bayern will not sell Tah in January. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images) While Tah may be well-liked by the club, previous reports have strongly suggested that the preference for Flick & co. is to sign a left-footed centre-back. Lisandro Martinez of Manchester United, whose contract expires in 2027, has emerged as the most realistic target for Barcelona . Meanwhile, there have also been tentative links to players like Real Betis’ Natan and Piero Hincapie of Arsenal. It remains to be seen who Barcelona go after to strengthen their backline during the upcoming January window. What seems certain is that a move for Tah is unlikely to pan out for the Catalans.

top.title: Oscar Piastri on Avoiding George Russell’s Stopped Car in São Paulo GP: ‘Scary’
top.description: Oscar Piastri called it “scary” after he and Isack Hadjar had to avoid George Russell’s spun Mercedes at the pit exit in the F1 São Paulo GP. The changing conditions caught out Mercedes’ Russell in the F1 São Paulo GP. After the pit stop, while on his way out of the pits, the Brit spun by himself , running over the curbs. He had switched to the slick compound on the greasy circuit. It was a scary moment, since several cars were leaving the pits at the same time. Red Bull’s Hadjar was directly behind him and had to avoid him quickly. Racing Bulls’ Liam Lawson was next, followed by McLaren’s Piastri. Obviously, he was stuck in the middle of the road, so it didn’t make things easy at all, but yeah, glad I could avoid it,” he said to the media. The Australian finished sixth after another difficult race, while teammate Lando Norris won. Russell, meanwhile, lost ground. nigeria.title: UK man convicted of fraud for secretly working five government jobs at once
nigeria.description: A 56-year-old civil servant in the United Kingdom, UK, Kashim Chowdhury has been convicted of nine counts of fraud after secretly holding multiple full-time government jobs and fraudulently earning more than £284,000 in taxpayers’ money. Chowdhury, from east London, held five overlapping government positions in the spring of 2023, concealing his multiple employment arrangements from the departments that hired him. After seven hours of deliberation, a jury unanimously found him guilty of eight counts of fraud by false representation and one count of fraud by failure to disclose. The prosecution accused Chowdhury of “deliberate, intentional dishonesty” and “exploiting the system” to secure multiple salaries from public sector employers. During the proceedings, the judge said Chowdhury faced a “very significant custodial sentence”. He also refused him bail, citing the seriousness of the offences and Chowdhury’s own wellbeing. Sarah Melo, a specialist prosecutor at the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) Serious Economic Organised Crime and International Directorate, described his actions as sustained dishonesty. “This was sustained and deliberate dishonesty,” Melo said. “He knew he could not legitimately hold multiple full-time positions at the same time, but continued to conceal what he was doing.” A spokesperson for the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) said Chowdhury had “abused the trust placed in him as a public servant”. The department added that it would use all available avenues to recover the proceeds of his offending. Between 2020 and 2023, Chowdhury held eight overlapping full-time public sector positions and earned a total of £350,000, according to evidence presented in court. Prosecutors told the court that he provided inaccurate information about his employment status on job application forms and failed to disclose to government departments that he was already employed as a civil servant. After securing the positions, he also failed to inform his employers that he was working for other government departments. Chowdhury was permitted to work entirely from home after telling his employers he was caring for his mother, with whom he lived in east London. His mother had dementia and was diagnosed with terminal cancer in 2023. However, rather than reduce his workload to care for her, he continued taking on additional government positions. In the spring of 2023, he held positions across the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, the Department of Health and Social Care, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), the Department for Business and Trade, the Food Standards Agency and the Home Office. During the period, he was contracted to work 183 hours a week, exceeding the total number of hours available in seven days. nigeria.title: Full list: Canada lists foreigners eligible for rural permanent residence
nigeria.description: Canada has outlined six eligibility requirements for foreign nationals seeking permanent residence through its Rural Community Immigration Program, a pathway designed to attract skilled immigrants to participating rural communities across the country. The programme offers permanent residence to eligible foreigners who want to work and settle in selected Canadian communities, particularly areas seeking skilled migrants to fill positions that cannot be filled by local residents. According to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), participating communities will approve designated employers to recruit skilled foreign nationals for available positions. To qualify for permanent residence under the programme, applicants must obtain a valid recommendation certificate from a participating community and secure a valid job offer from a designated employer within that community. They must also have at least one year, equivalent to 1,560 hours, of related work experience within the previous three years. Other requirements include demonstrating language proficiency through an approved test, possessing a Canadian educational credential or its foreign equivalent, and providing proof of sufficient funds to support themselves and their families. Full list of eligibility requirements According to IRCC, foreigners seeking permanent residence through the programme must meet the following six requirements: Community recommendation: Obtain a valid recommendation certificate from a participating community in Canada. Valid job offer: Secure a valid job offer from a designated employer within the participating community. Work experience: Have at least one year (1,560 hours) of related work experience within the past three years. Language proficiency: Demonstrate English or French language ability by taking an approved language test. Educational qualification: Possess a Canadian educational credential or a foreign equivalent. Proof of funds: Provide evidence of having sufficient money to support themselves and their families after arriving in Canada. The programme is designed to help participating rural communities attract skilled foreign nationals while providing immigrants with an opportunity to obtain permanent residence and establish themselves in Canada. Applicants are required to satisfy the eligibility conditions and secure the necessary community recommendation and employment offer before applying for permanent residence. nigeria.description: An explosion ripped through a steel plant in western Turkey on Monday, killing 16 people and injuring 13, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said, announcing investigations into the tragedy. Eight workers were trapped at the HABAS steel factory about 60 kilometres (37 miles) north of the port city of Izmir, where the blast struck around midday (0900 GMT), said Izmir governor Suleyman Elban. Footage posted online showed a huge cloud of thick smoke pouring into the sky as flames appeared to engulf a tall structure within the HABAS Demir Celik plant in Aliaga. “The circumstances surrounding this tragic incident, which has deeply saddened our nation, including how and why it happened, whether there was any negligence, and who bears responsibility, will be established,” Erdogan said on television. Crane Collapse According to Izmir’s governor, the blast was caused by an overhead crane that collapsed into a large industrial furnace used during the liquid steel casting process. “While a boiler replacement operation was being carried out at the HABAS iron and steel factory, the overhead crane fell and landed in the arc furnace, causing an explosion in the steel mill behind it,” Elban told reporters, referring to a large electric-powered steelmaking furnace. An eyewitness, Deniz Ulker, said it felt like an “earthquake”. “When I looked at the factory across the street, thick black smoke was coming out. A fire broke out where the chimney was,” Ulker told Anadolu news agency. “It was like a bomb going off,” said Turan Ilbay, who works as a truck driver at the factory and also spoke to Anadolu. Izmir mayor Cemil Tugay said on X that rescue teams were “continuing their work to remove the collapsed platform” and that those affected were factory workers. nigeria.title: Nasarawa APC protests alleged violence, SDP alleges bias
nigeria.description: By Edwin Philip, Lafia Members and supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Nasarawa State on Monday staged a protest in Lafia over alleged political violence, intimidation of party members and the disruption of the party’s presidential rally attended by Vice President Kashim Shettima. Addressing journalists and security officials during the demonstration, the state APC Chairman, Dr. Aliyu Bello, called for investigations into reported attacks on party supporters, including the alleged killing of a supporter in the Tudun Wada area of Lafia. Bello expressed concern over what he described as the failure of law enforcement agencies to act on complaints previously submitted by the party. He said the protest was organised to demand justice and adequate protection for party members, insisting that the APC remained committed to peaceful political activities. “We came here to demand justice that a full-scale investigation be carried out and the perpetrators of these acts arrested and prosecuted,” he said. The APC chairman also raised concerns about alleged threats and conduct by some opposition figures, calling on security agencies to ensure that all political actors operate within the law. Responding on behalf of Governor Abdullahi Sule, the Deputy Governor, Dr Emmanuel Akabe, described the reported incidents as a matter of concern and criticised the security arrangements surrounding the disruption of the Vice-President’s rally. Akabe said security agencies had been briefed ahead of Shettima’s visit and stressed that protecting lives and property remained their responsibility. “It is unfortunate because the responsibility of security men is to protect lives and property. If you cannot protect individuals in your state, then a lot needs to be answered,” he said. The deputy governor disclosed that the State Emergency Security Council had convened to consider measures to prevent further disturbances. He assured the protesters that the state government would support efforts to ensure that anyone found culpable was dealt with in accordance with the law. Speaking on behalf of the Nasarawa State Police Command, Assistant Commissioner of Police Gaya Ahmed reaffirmed the neutrality of security agencies and their commitment to investigating complaints. “The IGP has made it clear that the police are neutral, and we keep on maintaining that neutrality,” Ahmed said. He assured the protesters that petitions submitted by the APC would be forwarded to the incoming Commissioner of Police for investigation. A representative of the Department of State Services (DSS), the Deputy Director of Administration, also acknowledged receipt of the party’s complaints and commended the protesters for conducting themselves peacefully without obstructing public roads. However, the Nasarawa State chapter of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) criticised the demonstration, accusing the state government and the APC of using the protest to target opposition figures. nigeria.title: Court dismisses Maihaja’s suit against Wali’s APC ticket
nigeria.description: By Maryam Abdul-aziz Usman, Damaturu A Federal High Court sitting in Damaturu, Yobe State, has dismissed a suit challenging the emergence of Alhaji Baba Malam Wali as the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate for the 2027 general election. The suit was instituted by Engr. Mustapha Yunusa Maihaja, an aspirant in the party’s May 21 governorship primary, who alleged irregularities and non-compliance with the APC’s electoral guidelines. In a judgment delivered on Monday, November 9, 2026, Justice Fatima Murtala Amin held that the suit was statute-barred, having been filed outside the legally prescribed timeframe. The court also found that Maihaja failed to establish his allegations, particularly the claim of over-voting during the governorship primary. Justice Amin upheld a preliminary objection challenging the competence of the suit, thereby dismissing the case on procedural grounds. On the substantive issues, the judge identified material contradictions and inconsistencies in the testimonies of the plaintiff’s witnesses, describing the evidence as unreliable and insufficient to support the allegations. The court further held that even if the suit had been filed within the prescribed timeframe, it would still have failed on its merits because the plaintiff did not provide credible evidence to establish the alleged over-voting. Wali emerged winner of the APC governorship primary with 236,711 votes, securing the party’s ticket for the 2027 governorship election in the state. Reacting to the judgment, Wali’s Press Secretary, Shuaibu Abdullahi, commended the court for its consideration of the issues raised in the suit. “We commend the Court for its painstaking consideration of the issues and reaffirm our confidence in the judiciary as the ultimate guardian of justice and the rule of law,” Abdullahi said. The judgment dismisses the legal challenge to Wali’s emergence as the APC governorship candidate, leaving his party ticket intact ahead of the 2027 general election. nigeria.title: Offa robbery: Saraki faults Kwara govt over amended charges
nigeria.description: Former Senate President, Bukola Saraki, has criticised the Kwara State Government over its decision to amend the criminal charges filed against him and former Governor Abdulfatah Ahmed in connection with the 2018 Offa bank robbery. Saraki described the development as an abuse of the judicial process, questioning the basis for the government’s decision to drop 18 of the original 20 counts and proceed with an amended four-count charge. In a statement issued on Monday by his media aide, Yusuph Olaniyonu, the former Senate President accused the administration of Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq of pursuing the case for political reasons. The Kwara State Government had, in an application filed on Monday before the state High Court in Ilorin, sought permission to proceed with an amended four-count charge against Saraki, Ahmed and two other defendants. The amended charge, dated November 6, 2026, retains two allegations bordering on conspiracy to belong to a gang of thieves and belonging to a gang of thieves. It also introduces two additional counts relating to the alleged concealment of a Lexus RX Jeep bearing the inscription ‘SARAKI’ as its plate number. Reacting, Saraki said the government had abandoned 18 charges relating to armed robbery after allegedly failing to establish a case against him and Ahmed. He said the government had, since April 2026, been pursuing their arraignment at the State High Court and the Court of Appeal without success. “Last weekend, the state government that has set its legal team to be shuttling between the State High Court and the Court of Appeal seeking without success since April 2026 to arraign the two predecessors of Mr Abdulrazaq on charges of armed robbery suddenly made a U-turn and dropped all 18 charges relating to armed robbery on the Offa case,” the statement said. Saraki alleged that the decision to amend the charges followed the government’s inability to substantiate the allegations against the two former governors. “For fear of failure, the government has chosen to change gear and explore yet other baseless charges,” he said. He described the amendment as evidence, in his view, that the allegations against him and Ahmed lacked a credible factual foundation. “The amendment to the charge sheet only reveals that there was no case against these gentlemen from the beginning and what the state government is indulging in is abuse of powers, a travesty of the justice system, and mockery of the prosecutorial powers of the state,” he added. The former Senate President also questioned the government’s decision to discontinue the 18 counts after allegedly spending close to N100 million publicising its claims against the defendants in national newspapers earlier in the year. nigeria.title: Barcelona teenager Pau Cubarsí wins 2026 Golden Boy Award
nigeria.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Barcelona centre-back Pau Cubarsí has won the 2026 Golden Boy award, becoming the first defender since Matthijs de Ligt in 2018 to receive the honour. The 19-year-old was recognised after a standout year with Barcelona and Spain. He helped Barça win a second consecutive LaLiga title and was part of Spain’s World Cup-winning team in North America, where he was named Young Player of the Tournament. “I’m very proud to receive the award, and I thank all the people who voted for me,” Cubarsí said in a video broadcast by Tuttosport at the ceremony. “It’s been a spectacular year, and we’re going for more,” he added. Cubarsí told Reuters that defenders can struggle to attract the same attention as attacking players. “It’s harder for defenders to get recognition… we’re less in the spotlight,” he said. “Perhaps our work isn’t as visible because, at the end of the day, the forwards score lots of goals, provide assists, play a more attractive style of football, are more eye-catching.” Spain conceded only one goal in eight matches en route to winning the World Cup, and Cubarsí played a key role in the team’s defence. He becomes the fourth Barcelona player to win the men’s award in the last six years, following teammates Pedri, Gavi and Lamine Yamal. Previous winners include Lionel Messi, Kylian Mbappé and Erling Haaland. The Golden Boy award, established by Italian newspaper Tuttosport in 2003, recognises the best under-21 player in a top European division. Journalists vote from a shortlist of nominees. nigeria.title: Tinubu: Wike promises N10m reward for FCT Councillors who deliver for APC
nigeria.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: Minister of the Federal Capital Territory FCT, Nyesom Wike, has announced a financial incentive of N10 million for every councillor who successfully delivers their respective political ward for the All Progressives Congress APC and President Bola Tinubu in the upcoming general elections. Addressing stakeholders, traditional leaders, and political actors in Kwali, Wike explained that the initiative is part of a broad grassroots mobilisation strategy designed to rally maximum support at the grassroots level. “Any councillor that delivers his ward will get N10 million reward. Therefore, go and meet your leaders, go and meet your youth groups, go and consult with associations. Let’s deliver our ward to Mr President,” Wike urged the gathering. In addition to the electoral incentive, the FCT minister addressed structural and welfare concerns raised by local leaders, notably responding to an appeal by the Chairman of the National Councillors Forum of Nigeria (FCT Chapter), Gambo Hamza. Hamza had drawn attention to the disparity and low earnings of councillors in the territory – noting a monthly salary of N260,000 – which Wike termed unacceptable. The Minister promised to engage the permanent secretary and relevant administrative offices to review the remuneration structure, bypassing bureaucratic bottlenecks where possible to improve local governance welfare. Wike also underscored his administration’s dedication to gender inclusivity, emphasizing the need to increase women’s active participation in governance. Wike did not also mince words regarding what he described as the historical marginalisation of the FCT. He pointed out the stark disproportion in legislative distribution, questioning how a fast-growing population of six to seven million residents is restricted to only one Senate seat and a minimal number of House of Representatives seats. Comparing the FCT to other states with lesser populations boasting three senators and up to ten representatives, Wike maintained that structural fairness must be championed to give the nation’s capital adequate voice and equity. nigeria.title: Russell Brand jailed for 10 years for rape, assault
nigeria.description: British comedian and TV star Russell Brand was Monday jailed for more than 10 years for a string of sex offences including rape, as the judge told him he had been a “sexual predator” whose fame had protected him. Brand, 51, showed no emotion as judge Joel Bennathan said he had acted with “staggering arrogance” and shown “contempt” for his victims, who had suffered significant and lasting harm. “About 20 years ago Russell Brand, you were becoming famous, you were clever, and in many people’s eyes you were funny and charismatic. You had also become a sexual predator,” he said. The judge said Brand’s status protected him until he was exposed in 2023 by journalists from the Sunday Times, The Times and the Channel 4 Dispatches programme, leading to women coming forward to make complaints to police. Bennathan paid tribute to the “determination and bravery” of the women, adding Brand had repeatedly acted “how you liked and when you liked, unhindered by the rules by which decent people live”. Brand’s wife Laura Gallacher, with whom he has three children, slumped in her seat in the public gallery of London’s Southwark Crown Court as the total sentence of 10 years and six months was announced. Brand told his wife, who has supported him in court throughout the case, “we’ll be OK”, before being led down to the cells. The disgraced star was convicted by a jury last week of one rape and three sexual assaults committed against four women between 2004 and 2009. Brand, who has reinvented himself as an online Christian guru, held a string of prayer beads and made the sign of the cross before one of his victims personally read out her impact statement from behind a screen. The hearing came as Prime Minister Andy Burnham pledged to be “relentless in making whatever improvements we can” to provide more support for victims. nigeria.title: 2027: Stop following Tinubu to rallies, return to grassroots, Kalu tells APC leaders
nigeria.description: Senator Orji Uzor Kalu has urged leaders of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to stop following President Bola Tinubu from one campaign rally to another and concentrate on grassroots mobilisation in their respective states, local government areas and wards ahead of the 2027 general elections. Kalu, who represents Abia North Senatorial District and serves as Coordinator of Parliamentary Mobilisation for the South-East, made the call in a statement titled, “The APC Presidential Campaign Council and the Need for a Leaner Campaign Train.” He argued that Tinubu should be accompanied by a smaller campaign team, while other party leaders should remain in their respective political bases to engage voters and strengthen the party’s grassroots structures. The senator’s position comes days after the APC Presidential Campaign Council issued guidelines restricting ministers, political appointees and campaign council members to rallies organised in their respective home states. The circular, signed by the Director-General of the council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, on November 3, was addressed to directors and heads of directorates. It directed political appointees and other campaign officials to attend only rallies in their home states as part of efforts to improve coordination and grassroots mobilisation. The council also adopted what it described as the pyramid concept of mobilisation, which prioritises engagement at polling unit, ward, local government and state levels. Under the arrangement, campaign officials and party leaders are expected to concentrate on building support at the grassroots rather than concentrating around the President during rallies. Kalu cited his political activities in Abia State as an example of the importance of grassroots mobilisation. He recalled leading more than 4,000 APC members in his Igbere Ward A, Bende Local Government Area, during the party’s presidential primary in May. He said the exercise demonstrated the importance of building political support from the ward level. At the exercise, the returning officer, Mr Ulu Onwuchekwa, announced that Tinubu scored 4,986 votes in the ward. Tinubu had also urged members of the campaign council to take responsibility for mobilisation across the country, saying he would concentrate on governance. The President made the appeal on October 14 during the inauguration of the Presidential Campaign Council in Abuja. The campaign was subsequently flagged off in Kaduna on October 24, with plans to take the campaign to all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. Tinubu is, however, expected to personally attend rallies in only 12 states. nigeria.title: Man Utd delay decision on Carrick’s future after dropping into relegation zone — report
nigeria.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Manchester United are not in a hurry to sack head coach Michael Carrick despite their drop into the Premier League relegation zone following Sunday’s 4-4 draw with Aston Villa, according to Sky Sports . Sky Sports News reports that the club’s hierarchy plan to use the international break to assess the team’s poor start to the season and reconsider their options before making a decision on Carrick’s future. The former United midfielder is under increasing pressure after the club recorded just one win in 11 matches, conceded 30 goals in all competitions and endured what has been described as their worst-ever start to a Premier League campaign. United’s 4-4 draw against Villa followed another comeback in their previous match, but the recent results have not been enough to ease concerns over their overall performances. Carrick and his players were given Monday off after the Villa encounter, with the head coach and his staff expected to return to the club’s Carrington training base on Tuesday. With several players away on international duty and no first-team training sessions scheduled in the coming days, the break is expected to give the club’s leadership time to conduct a broader review. According to Sky Sports, three major factors have contributed to the hierarchy’s decision not to rush a change in the dugout. First, United supporters have not called for Carrick to be dismissed, with the former midfielder still enjoying considerable affection from the fanbase because of his achievements as a player. Carrick won 11 major trophies during his playing career at Old Trafford, including the Champions League and five Premier League titles. Secondly, the club’s hierarchy believe the 45-year-old still has the support of the dressing room, despite the team’s poor form. The recent comebacks against Roma in the Champions League and Aston Villa in the Premier League are understood to have reinforced the belief that the players have not given up on their manager. Thirdly, United’s decision-makers are reportedly not convinced that replacing Carrick would automatically resolve the team’s problems, with the performances of the players also under scrutiny. The report adds that the club could consider available managerial options, including Julian Nagelsmann and Eddie Howe, if they eventually decide to make a change. For now, however, United are expected to take their time before deciding whether Carrick remains the right man to lead the club out of their current crisis. nigeria.title: Joe Biden scales back book tour as cancer ‘slows me down’
nigeria.description: Former US president Joe Biden says he is scaling back plans to promote his upcoming memoir as he battles aggressive prostate cancer, acknowledging that the illness sometimes leaves him struggling. The 83-year-old Democrat, whose health was a major issue during his presidency, said Sunday that he would be unable to make as many public appearances as he had hoped ahead of the November 17 release of “Promise Me, America.” “Some days are better than others. It hasn’t stopped me. But sometimes it slows me down,” Biden wrote on X. “What that means is, unfortunately, I won’t be able to do as many conversations about my book as I’d hoped. However, I’m hopeful the words on the page speak for themselves.” Biden announced in May 2025, four months after leaving the White House, that he had been diagnosed with an aggressive form of prostate cancer that had spread to his bones. He has since undergone radiation and hormone therapy, while his son Hunter said in August that the disease had spread further and was causing considerable pain. Biden struck an optimistic note about his treatment, saying his doctors “continue to be encouraged” by his response. His memoir chronicles his four years in the White House, including his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic, wars in Afghanistan and Ukraine, and his controversial decision to seek reelection in 2024 before withdrawing. In an excerpt published Monday by The Atlantic, Biden delivered a blistering attack on his successor Donald Trump over the 2021 assault on the US Capitol by supporters seeking to overturn Trump’s election defeat. “What Trump did on January 6, 2021, should never be forgotten. It should follow him to his grave,” Biden wrote. He also recalled an unexpectedly friendly Oval Office meeting with Trump following the Republican’s 2024 election victory, during which his successor suggested they might have been friends outside politics. Biden abandoned his reelection campaign in July 2024 after a disastrous debate against Trump intensified concerns about his age and fitness for office. His vice president, Kamala Harris, subsequently lost the election, returning Trump to the White House. Biden said his book would explain the decisions he made in office and reflect his faith in American democracy. nigeria.description: The management of Babcock University, Ilishan-Remo, Ogun State, has confirmed that a student involved in an incident at one of the institution’s residential facilities is alive and currently receiving medical attention at the university’s teaching hospital. This was communicated in a statement signed by the Associate Vice President, Communication, Media and Branding of the institution, Johnson Akintayo, who dismissed media reports suggesting that the student, whose identity is not disclosed, had died. The university said the student was receiving medical treatment alongside his roommate, who also sustained injuries during the incident. A video that surfaced online on Monday showed a student attempting to jump through the window of one of the university’s hostels as his roommates struggled to prevent him from attempting suicide. Following the incident, some media reports claimed that the student had died. “Contrary to reports suggesting that the student may have died, we wish to assure the public that he is responding positively to treatment and is receiving the necessary medical care,” Akintayo said. “The incident was brought under control by the commendable and prompt intervention of the student’s roommates, whose timely action prevented what could have been a more tragic outcome. “The student with one of his rescuers, however, sustained injuries in the process and were immediately taken for medical attention.” He further stated that the student’s parents had been contacted and were on campus to be with their ward as he receives treatment. Babcock University is a private tertiary institution in South-West Nigeria. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the operators minted at least six new tokens on the NEAR blockchain — named FUK, OLCCL, MEILI, MMLI, DABI and SINU — paired each with NEAR in its own liquidity pool, then bought the tokens with stolen NEAR and sold them back out through a second set of wallets. About 117,000 NEAR, or roughly $430,000, passed through the six tokens, Elliptic wrote . The trail sits inside the broader laundering of the Oct. 29 Binance theft, which the exchange has put at $6.34 billion and which the FBI has attributed to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. Elliptic’s wider update now puts roughly 3,000 BTC — about $225 million — in new bitcoin addresses converted from other stolen assets, while about 11.8 million NEAR, or $43.7 million, from the theft has still not moved. “Most people think of meme tokens as joke coins whose prices rise and fall on hype,” Elliptic co-founder and chief scientist Dr. Tom Robinson wrote. “North Korea’s launderers have found a different use for them.” How the homemade token trick works The technique is a four-step hop. At no point do the stolen funds transfer directly from a buying wallet to a collecting wallet, because the pool sits in between. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT Large bitcoin holders are swapping coins they guard themselves for shares of BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) at a record pace, the firm’s head of digital assets said Monday, as kidnappings and hacks push security to the top of their list. “The current moment is the highest we’ve seen at any point,” Robbie Mitchnick told Barron’s , adding that demand for the swaps “has sort of been one way — up.” Of all the reasons clients give, he said, “the single largest one is security and peace of mind.” The trades are in-kind conversions. A holder delivers bitcoin to the fund through an intermediary and receives newly created IBIT shares, without first selling the coins for cash. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too FinCEN and the Federal Reserve have formally withdrawn a 2020 proposal that would have cut the Bank Secrecy Act threshold for cross-border funds transfers from $3,000 to $250 and spelled out that the rules cover crypto, leaving the existing $3,000 line in place. The notice, published Monday in the Federal Register, says the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network and the Fed’s Board of Governors “will not take further action” on a proposal they first issued on Oct. 27, 2020. That plan would have lowered the recordkeeping and Travel Rule thresholds to $250 for transfers that begin or end outside the United States. Those rules require banks and nonbank financial institutions to collect, retain and pass along customer information on transfers of $3,000 or more. It also would have clarified the meaning of “money” in both rules so they apply to transactions involving convertible virtual currency, along with digital assets that have legal tender status to a recipient. Why the agencies backed off Per the notcie, FinCEN and the Fed received nearly 3,000 comments on the proposal, most of them substantially similar form letters. Commenters generally opposed the lower threshold, arguing that it would burden smaller institutions and could push consumers sending remittances toward less regulated channels. Many also noted that potentially illicit transfers below $3,000 were already being flagged to FinCEN through suspicious activity reports. Several said the threshold should rise instead, citing inflation since 1995. Sentiment on the crypto language was mixed. Companies that provide crypto services and their trade groups opposed it, citing technical limits and the lack of an international messaging standard for crypto transfers, while some banks and money services businesses supported it. The agencies gave two reasons for pulling the proposal. More than five years have passed, and they said more public feedback would help before adopting anything similar. The withdrawal, they wrote, gives the public “certainty” that no final rule will be issued without another chance to comment. The second reason is the crypto industry itself. The notice says crypto markets “have continued to mature” and new legal frameworks are emerging, citing the GENIUS Act stablecoin law enacted on July 18, 2025. Any future change tied to crypto, the agencies said, should be considered in light of those developments so it is “fit for purpose.” What the withdrawal does and does not do The notice does not repeal or amend any rule. The $3,000 threshold that has applied for decades stays where it is, and so does the existing Travel Rule. What disappears is the specific path to $250 and the proposed wording that would have written crypto into the definition of money. entertainment.title: Israel Olaleye: What Selling Land Taught Me About How Nigerians Think About Money
entertainment.description: In 2021, I graduated from the University of Ibadan with a degree in Mathematics. I thought my life would be about numbers on a whiteboard. I did not know it would become about numbers in people’s bank accounts, and the fears, hopes and contradictions that sit behind them. By mid-2023, I had taken a job selling real estate. I started at the very bottom, as a sales development representative: the person who makes the first call, sends the message and follows up when nobody replies. Today, I manage a sales team. Somewhere between then and now, I stopped seeing real estate as a business of land and buildings. I started seeing it as a mirror. Put a property in front of a Nigerian, and you will learn, very quickly, how they think about money. Here is some of what that mirror has shown me: A prospect once told me, with complete confidence, “I have my money ready for the land.” We fixed an inspection. We walked the site together under the afternoon sun, red earth on our shoes. Then, standing on the plot, the prospect asked if they could pay next year. I was not angry. I understood. Saying “I am ready” feels good. Being ready is different. It means you have decided what the money is for, and you are willing to let it go. I have seen versions of that moment many times. The client who books an inspection for 2 pm and is still not there at 4 pm. The person who asks for options, receives ten properties that match exactly what they requested, and replies, “Do you have something else?” The buyer who is ready until it is time to decide, and then needs three more months to think. The one who disappeared after asking for a price came back after the price went up, and asked for the old price. For a long time, these moments frustrated me. But they taught me that most people do not have a money problem. They have a decision problem. We are a generation that earns, spends, plans and postpones, often all at the same time. You can earn a lot and still not be wealthy One idea I keep returning to is that you can earn twenty million naira a year and still not be wealthy. Income is what comes in. Wealth is what stays and grows. Two people can earn the same salary and end up in completely different places ten years later, simply because one converted part of that income into assets and the other converted all of it into lifestyle. entertainment.title: From the Sky to the Earth To You: Earth & Sky by Banke Kuku
entertainment.description: With Earth & Sky , her Spring/Summer 2027 collection, Banke Kuku turns to nature’s most essential cycle: the sky gives rain, the rain feeds the earth, and the earth gives back. Reimagining the water cycle as a circle of life, the collection celebrates the abundance that flows from it. Earth & Sky is built around seven prints in three families. The Sky family is led by the hero print, Bougainvillea Sky, with watercolour bougainvillea, bees, butterflies and birds drifting across a turquoise ground, alongside Dove Sky and Daybreak Sky. The Earth family, Yellow Trumpet and Flower Bud, draws on flowering plants such as Costus spectabilis . The Rain family pairs Raindrop, a glossy, near-photographic print set against the softness of the watercolours, with the Kuku Monogram in fresh colourways. Sky prints are finished with hand-embroidered clouds and raindrops on flowing kaftans and kimono robes. Speaking on the inspiration, Creative Director Banke Kuku shares: “I never start with a sketch. I start with a feeling, and for Earth & Sky, that feeling was abundance. This year I became a mother for the first time, and everywhere I looked, nature was reflecting that same fullness back at me. This is my most personal collection.” A CYCLE OF GIVING BACK In nature, nothing is wasted, and everything returns. Earth & Sky carries that principle as its message: what we take from the earth, we must give back. That principle extends into how Banke Kuku approaches production. The brand maintains a no-waste policy, finding uses for offcuts rather than discarding them, while its seasonless approach allows pieces to remain part of the collection beyond a single season. Banke Kuku also uses digital printing, which consumes less heat and water than conventional printing methods, and continues to reduce its use of man-made fabrics in favour of more conscious material choices. sports.title: Lexi Thompson believes WTGL will help grow the game of golf
sports.description: LPGA golfers pose for a photo during WTGL Media Day at SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida on September 20, 2026. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co The future is here. WTGL kicked off on Sunday, Los Angeles Golf Club defeated New York , and it is already back in action. Tuesday will see L.A. take on Motor City Golf Club, Lexi Thompson’s team. Women’s golf has grown so much over the last 20 years and that time span just about directly coincides with Lexi’s professional career. Everyone remembers her making her U.S. Open debut in 2007 at the age of 12, and in the time since she has piled up the wins, titles, and now has a spot in the startup league… while pregnant to boot. Lexi was kind enough to take some time to join me for a conversation about WTGL on Monday. You can watch it in its entirety below. As noted I find Lexi to be such an important figure in the world of golf at large. She has been such a trailblazer in the game, and she continues to be with WTGL in general, but that she is taking it on while carrying a child is an entirely different level of impressiveness. Lexi and her fellow WTGL players have all talked about what an opportunity the league represents for them and the next generation. In Lexi’s case she is quite literally carrying that generation to and through her WTGL experience. This year may mark the first literal season of WTGL, but it has been in the works for a long time if you really think about it. What the Lexi Thompsons of the world have done, many of whom share the WTGL experience with her, over the course of their careers has helped to open the door of possibility for all involved. Here’s to seeing what they and those they continue to inspire can do next. Tuesday’s match between Motor City Golf Club and Los Angeles Golf Club can be seen on Ion at 7pm CT.

sports.title: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report
sports.description: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report In a major development, Florian Plettenberg of Sky Germany reports that Barcelona have made an enquiry for Bayern Munich defensive mainstay Jonathan Tah. The Blaugrana are scouring the market for an experienced defender to partner Pau Cubarsi at the heart of the defence and see the German international as an appealing target. Tah back on Barcelona’s radar Tah is a name very familiar to Barcelona, considering that they had shown a strong interest in signing him back in 2025, when his contract at Bayer Leverkusen was expiring. The La Liga champions explored the possibility of a move but decided not to sign him, and he ended up moving to Bayern Munich. Since joining the Bundesliga title holders, the 30-year-old has grown into a mainstay at the back, racking up 67 appearances in which he has three goals and assists each. Back on Barcelona’s radar. (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images) As per the report, Barcelona director Deco and manager Hansi Flick continue to rate Tah highly, and therefore, an enquiry has now been made regarding his availability. January move not an option However, the journalist states that, as things stand, a January move for Tah is not seen as viable for Barcelona. The German international is settled well at Bayern Munich, who themselves have no intentions of letting the centre-back leave the club in January. As such, Barça’s interest is unlikely to proceed beyond the enquiry that has been made for the 30-year-old defender, whose contract at the Allianz Arena runs until the summer of 2029. Bayern will not sell Tah in January. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images) While Tah may be well-liked by the club, previous reports have strongly suggested that the preference for Flick & co. is to sign a left-footed centre-back. Lisandro Martinez of Manchester United, whose contract expires in 2027, has emerged as the most realistic target for Barcelona . Meanwhile, there have also been tentative links to players like Real Betis’ Natan and Piero Hincapie of Arsenal. It remains to be seen who Barcelona go after to strengthen their backline during the upcoming January window. What seems certain is that a move for Tah is unlikely to pan out for the Catalans.

sports.title: Oscar Piastri on Avoiding George Russell’s Stopped Car in São Paulo GP: ‘Scary’
sports.description: Oscar Piastri called it “scary” after he and Isack Hadjar had to avoid George Russell’s spun Mercedes at the pit exit in the F1 São Paulo GP. The changing conditions caught out Mercedes’ Russell in the F1 São Paulo GP. After the pit stop, while on his way out of the pits, the Brit spun by himself , running over the curbs. He had switched to the slick compound on the greasy circuit. It was a scary moment, since several cars were leaving the pits at the same time. Red Bull’s Hadjar was directly behind him and had to avoid him quickly. Racing Bulls’ Liam Lawson was next, followed by McLaren’s Piastri. Nem eu acredito que fiz essa foto https://t.co/MxtQa0I09Q — Sam Pancher (@SamPancher) November 8, 2026 Piastri Says Russell Was Stuck in the Middle of the Road It was scary for Piastri . “Scary. Obviously, he was stuck in the middle of the road, so it didn’t make things easy at all, but yeah, glad I could avoid it,” he said to the media. The Australian finished sixth after another difficult race, while teammate Lando Norris won. Russell, meanwhile, lost ground. However, the changing conditions helped him gain places by the end of the F1 Grand Prix, and he eventually finished fourth ahead of teammate Andrea Kimi Antonelli. Russell Admits He Went for a Risky Move Image Credit: Rudy Carezzevoli/Getty Images Russell admitted he had taken a risk and paid the price. “I’m not really too sure what happened, but I went quite high risk because I smelled an opportunity and paid the price,” he said to the media. “It’s in those moments where you either gain a lot, or you lose a lot. This time it went against us. Ironically, because of that, I didn’t pit, and kind of brought myself back into the race. “But we showed really strong pace on the soft. I’d say on the soft tire we had the fastest race pace, and it’s been quite a while since I’ve had the fastest race pace, so I would take the positives of that,” said Russell. His fourth place and Antonelli’s fifth helped Mercedes secure the 2026 F1 constructors’ championship .

That’s the second-highest total for a two-month period since NIL Go’s launch last year. Between Sept. 1 and Oct. 31, a total of 10,092 NIL deal were cleared by the system with an aggregate value of $192.62 million, according to the CSC. On the other side, 581 deals worth $20.21 million were not cleared. The other 3,493 deals were with non-associated entities with a value of $52.09 million – the highest total value for non-associated deals during the 2026 calendar year. The CSC said it took action on 175 NIL deals per day during September and October, and 48% of those deals had resolutions within a week of filling out all required fields. There has also been an increase in “complexity” of submitted deals, which includes clarity about the funding source of deals and money from schools used to fund a third-party “sponsor” that, otherwise, is not seeking a profit. technology.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
technology.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a recently discovered critical vulnerability that allows them to log in to privileged accounts on many Linux systems, multiple researchers are reporting. The vulnerability, tracked under the name *sshole, arises from the interaction between OpenSSH and a code library known as musl. Linux systems that use both of these packages and meet certain other requirements can be hacked to give unauthenticated access to high-privilege accounts in a matter of seconds. *sshole became publicly known last Thursday and quickly stoked concerns it could lead to widespread compromise of Linux machines. Four days later, the prediction shows signs of becoming real. Attackers conducting "mature intrusions" Security firm Greynoise said Monday that honeypots it maintains in Southeast Asia have come under attack by a group it’s tracking as GT10. The group conducted “mature intrusions" into the systems, which Greynoise uses to detect attempted or successful attacks in real time. Greynoise subsequently gained access to a GT10 server that revealed potential other victims and some of the tools used in the campaign. A backdoor the group is using in the attacks contains Chinese language comments and appears to be generated with the use of AI. Read full article Comments

technology.title: Pentagon mulls placing fleet of military satellites around the Moon
technology.description: The US military has published a Request for Information on a federal procurement website signaling interest in deploying a "proliferated cislunar constellation" consisting of an unspecified number of satellites performing an undisclosed mission in the vicinity of the Moon. The announcement follows statements in recent months from the Space Force's acquisitions chief for advanced programs, Maj. Gen. Stephen Purdy, that the military was getting serious about extending its reach to the Moon. The Space Force's most distant satellites today are in geostationary orbit, some 22,000 miles (36,000 kilometers) over the equator, collecting routine surveillance and missile warning data. Most recently, Purdy spoke of a shift in Pentagon leadership's thinking about the Moon following an executive order signed by President Donald Trump last December. The order set out the Trump administration's space policy. One section of the order deals with the US government's ability to detect, characterize, and counter threats to US space interests from low-Earth orbit to cislunar space, the term of art for the region of space around the Moon. technology.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
technology.description: Claude Code is leaking sensitive information on public GitHub instances thanks to a partial oversight in the way its settings files are handled. That's the finding of AI security researchers at Apiiro, who discovered thousands of secrets , including database passwords, API tokens, and root logins, amid Claude Code settings files embedded in GitHub repositories. The leak stems from the way Claude Code handles user approval for automated shell commands. When a user chooses the "Yes, and don't ask again" option to approve running a command, that choice gets stored as part of a rule in the local ".claude/settings.local.json" file on the user's computer. That rule is sometimes coded as a pattern, but the command itself is often written to that settings file as is, including any sensitive information that may be embedded within it. This isn't really a significant security issue if the settings file stays on the user's local machine (assuming that machine doesn't become compromised itself, of course). And Anthropic notes in its Claude Code documentation that this particular settings file gets added to the developer's global .gitignore list , which usually prevents it from being shared publicly. A new study , published Monday in the latest issue of The Astrophysical Journal, details the discovery of a previously hidden companion object that keeps pulling material away from the massive star every 113 days as they orbit one another. This partner is either a stellar-mass black hole, or the dense collapsed core of a massive star called a neutron star. This is the first X-ray detection of one of this class of erupting stars. It is also the first of these objects found with a black hole or neutron star companion. The volatile star, known as AT 2016blu, is in the spiral galaxy NGC 4559, located about 30 million light-years from Earth. Astronomers estimate the mass of this star is at least 33 times that of the Sun. “For 15 years, astronomers have been watching this star get really bright and then dim again on a regular basis,” said Mojgan Aghakhanloo of the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, who led this study. “Until we were able to get Chandra data at the right time, we couldn’t figure out what was making this happen.” The star AT 2016blu is a type of luminous blue variable, which are hot, massive stars characterized by changes in brightness. The Starfish satellite was flying a mission for NASA called Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability, or SSPICY for short. Netflix's sci-fi sensation returns in the live-action prequel series "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure." Created by the Duffer Brothers and Kate Trefry, with the episodes set to be directed by Joe Wright ("Darkest Hour", "Black Mirror"), this new show isn't set in Hawkins or the electric '80s. No, this time around, the action takes place in Marion, Nevada, in 1955, and you know what else is located in Nevada, right? Area 51 . The teaser trailer certainly teases the possibility of a trip to the world's most paradoxically famous secret military base, showcasing a bike and radio resting outside of a fence with a sign that clearly says it's a restricted area (in any TV show or film, that's actually an invitation to see what's on the other side). Of course, the tease doesn't end there, as the thunder booms in the sky and there's a visual hint of a wormhole. No story details about "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure" have been released to date, but there are some clues out there for all the Internet sleuths. Trefrey wrote the Henry Creel-focused "Stranger Things: The First Shadow" play, while Matt Duffer explained to Variety how a spin-off show would tackle the rock that Henry found in the briefcase in "Stranger Things." So, yes, expect this to be a Henry-centric affair and the start of his long, hard road to hell and becoming Vecna. After all, it was on April 12, 1955, that CIA officer Richard Bissell discovered the site, while the "Other Worlds" trailer has the date of April 19th clearly marked onscreen, so the timelines align nicely here. science.title: NASA’s ESCAPADE Completes Powered Earth Flybys, Now En Route to Mars
science.description: NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft have each successfully completed a powered Earth flyby, using Earth’s gravity in combination with a sustained engine burn to slingshot themselves toward Mars. With these successful maneuvers complete, the twin spacecraft are on target to reach the Red Planet in September 2027. “This is the first time NASA has used a powered Earth flyby to propel a spacecraft toward Mars, and we’ve now executed this maneuver twice, flawlessly, in just two days,” said Asal Naseri, acting associate flight director for the Heliophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington. To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video In November 2026, each of NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft executed a powered flyby of Earth, combining Earth’s gravity with an engine burn, to slingshot itself toward Mars. The first spacecraft made its closest approach around 5 a.m. EST on Saturday, Nov. 7, and the second did so two days later, around 6 a.m. EST on Monday, Nov. 9. In this animation, each spacecraft’s approximately 9-minute trans-Mars injection burn appears as an orange arc along the spacecraft’s trajectory. Advanced Space/Matt Bolliger The two ESCAPADE spacecraft launched from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on Nov. 13, 2025, when Earth and Mars were on opposite sides of the Sun. So instead of heading straight for the Red Planet, as most other Mars missions have done, both spacecraft entered a “loiter” or “Earth-proximity” orbit. They charted a first-of-its-kind, kidney-bean-shaped course around a place in space about a million miles from Earth called Lagrange point 2, which is a gravitational balancing point on the opposite side of Earth from the Sun. Then they headed back toward Earth to perform this gravitational slingshot maneuver around our planet once Earth and Mars were favorably aligned. science.title: Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find
science.description: Thanks to a combination of radar, infrasound, dash-cam and security camera footage, astronomers have tracked the bright daytime meteor that fell over Cape Cod Bay in May 2026 back to its origin as a small asteroid perturbed by Jupiter and sent on a comet-like orbit towards Earth. Meteor fireballs visible in the daytime are referred to as 'bolides'. At 1:06 p.m. local time (18:06 UTC) on May 30, 2026 one such bolide was widely witnessed falling out of the sky over coastal Massachusetts, with members of the public also reporting an associated sonic boom that rumbled across the north-eastern coast of the United States. Now, a team of scientists from Europe and the United States, led by space physicist Juha Vierinen of the Arctic University of Norway in Tromsø, have patched together measurements from a meteor-observing radar network, regular weather radar, infrasound stations and camera footage to fully characterize the fall of this meteoroid and trace its orbit around the sun . Key to these observations were measurements by the Spread Spectrum Interferometric Meteor Observing Network (SIMONe) based at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology's (MIT's) Haystack Observatory. SIMONe is a project jointly developed by MIT, the Arctic University of Norway and the Leibniz Institute of Atmospheric Physics in Kühlungsborn, Germany. "We were fortunate that the event occurred within the coverage of SIMONe," Vierinen told Space.com. This is echoed by Ryan Volz, a radio scientist at Haystack Observatory who is a member of the team who studied the May 30 bolide. "We got pretty lucky to observe this one," Volz told Space.com. "A bolide like this would have to enter the atmosphere within about 62 miles (100 kilometers) of a SIMONe-like meteor radar system for the head echoes we saw to be detectable, and there are only a handful of places in the world that currently meet that criteria." A head echo is what radar sees when a meteoroid – what we call the lump of rock that becomes a meteor while it is still in space – enters Earth's atmosphere , generating a cloud of plasma around it as it superheats the atmosphere and its outer surface. "The head echoes give the best constraints on the meteoroid's trajectory," said Volz. The existence of the head echo is usually very brief, taking place at 56 miles (90 kilometers () altitude down to about 44 miles (71 kilometers) when the plasma around the meteoroid is dense enough to return a radar echo. The head echo transitions into a 'trail echo', which is produced by a streak of turbulent plasma that is left in the wake of the meteoroid after it has passed through a given part of the atmosphere. In the case of the 30 May bolide, the trail echo was detected down to an unusually low altitude of 20 miles (32 kilometers), at which point the falling rock fragmented with an explosive force equivalent to 500 tons of TNT, whereas the total impact energy of the bolide was in the region on 1.1 kilotons of TNT.
